QR SLOP · free, in your browser

Make a QR code with your logo

A branded code for packaging, menus, posters and business cards: your logo in the middle, your colours on the dots. QR SLOP sets the error correction to the highest level so the code still scans.

Add a logo to a QR code

How to do it

  1. Fill in the Content tab: a web address, text, contact, Wi-Fi or another type.
  2. In the Logo tab, drop your logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG) or pick a built-in mark, and set its width up to 22% of the code.
  3. In the Design tab, choose the dot colour or a gradient, square or rounded modules, and the background (or transparent).
  4. Scan the preview with your phone, then download a PNG or an SVG.

Your files stay on this device: QR SLOP runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Will a QR code with a logo still scan?

Yes, if the logo stays small. QR SLOP switches to error correction H while a logo is in the centre and keeps the logo to at most 22% of the width. Always test the printed code.

Can I download it as a vector?

Yes. The SVG download keeps the code sharp at any size, with the logo inside.

Does the code expire?

No. The link or text is stored in the code itself, with no redirect service in between, so it works as long as the address it points to does.
